scope: Read-only historical local evidence audit. No model, ORCA, remote execution, or v3 mutation performed.
historical_compatibility_note: v3 evidence is a historical predecessor; never treat its passed gates as v4 evidence or user acceptance of this report.
preferred_claims: Benchmark1.2 core final saved grading: 18/18 frozen items, one run per canonical scientific item. 16 items execute ORCA; C003 clarification and C004 unsupported refusal execute none.
Core uses real deepseek-flash Semantic and Answer calls and real ORCA6.1.1 through production Agent.handle_message and public scripted confirmation. The harness does not inject Request or Plan.
The 23 ORCA attempts include an intentionally forced MaxIter=1 optimization failure in C005 followed by one validated model-selected repair; 22/23 is not an unbiased success-rate estimate.
Scientific Matrix 11 cells/16 ORCA calculations is developer scientific-execution probing with fixed Request/Plan fixtures, zero LLM/PubChem/repair. It is not end-to-end autonomous evidence.
Scientific checks verify convergence, bound geometry, Hessian/mode completeness and local minimum support. No external high-accuracy electronic-energy or experimental benchmark reference is present.
limitations: Core/full/holdout are different profiles: only smoke/core and Scientific Matrix runs cited; full and holdout not run.
Core frozen canonical prompts explicitly prescribe task, method, charge, spin and usually XYZ. Five dialogue scenarios have scripted user turns and public confirmation.

C001 scripted second-method change is part of the scenario, not unrecorded manual correction. There is no evidence of manual alteration of final Run data, but absence of all human intervention beyond the harness cannot be proven.
Final grading changed C004 ground truth to allow deterministic unsupported refusal and regraded an unchanged saved observation. This is calibration, not an independent rerun.
Reports record f03c695 as HEAD while implementation and dataset existed in a dirty worktree; no dirty-tree hash. Source inspection at current HEAD may differ from execution time.
Wall time is one local measurement and includes harness/model/tool time. Matrix elapsed cell sums 421.50 s while summary whole-run wall time is 421.516 s; do not mix them.
No price/monetary cost is established; report measured token, call and wall-time budgets only.

Different molecules absolute total energies cannot be ranked as chemical stability; different methods electronic energies are reported side by side or as explicitly defined method difference, not accuracy.
Historical M0 used 2048 MB and MaxCore384, whereas cited September24 matrix/core use1024 MB and MaxCore192; do not aggregate resource conditions.
